description: This file defines the EcsCredentialProvider class used for fetching container credentials in AWS ECS environments. It includes methods for constructing credential requests, handling authorization tokens, and parsing responses.

classes.name: EcsCredentialProvider
classes.description: Class responsible for providing AWS ECS container credentials by making HTTP requests to the container metadata service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with optional configuration parameters such as timeout, retries, and custom HTTP client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads container credentials asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of attempts made to fetch credentials.

methods.name: getEcsAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the ECS authorization token from environment variables or files.

methods.name: getHeadersForAuthToken
methods.description: Constructs headers containing the authorization token for credential requests.

methods.name: setHeaderForAuthToken
methods.description: Deprecated method for setting header for auth token, returns headers.

methods.name: getEcsUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for the container metadata service based on environment variables.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Decodes and validates the JSON response containing credentials.

methods.name: isCompatibleUri
methods.description: Checks whether the provided URI is valid and compatible for credential fetching.
